children: BancFirst announced a $0.52 per share common stock dividend and a trust preferred dividend tied to its BFC Capital Trust II interest payment.
Board declared $0.52 per share cash dividend on common stock, payable Oct 15, 2026 to shareholders of record Sep 30, 2026.
Quarterly interest payment on $26.8M of 7.20% junior subordinated debentures will be paid by BancFirst.
BFC Capital Trust II will use interest proceeds to pay $0.45 per share dividend on trust preferred securities, payable Oct 15, 2026 to holders of record Sep 30, 2026.
